name: Signature
notes: Our first companion-bearing scene -- decomposes Draknora's own D&D-flair armor/jewelry/sword (hero-signature) + Pyraxis her aligned Elder Dragon (companion, separate from the environment) + a reused universal footwear piece, grounded in prompts/_archive/Draknora/final/{Draknora_Qwen_Dragon_1,Draknora_Qwen_Fire_Dragon}.json. The generic unnamed dragon in the archive is named here (Pyraxis) per the codex's Element Alignment table (Fire). Pose uses motion/standing/three-quarter-glamour.json (switched from side-profile-elegant.json -- a true side profile hid too much of her face for a signature card; a 3/4 turn keeps most of the face toward camera while still reading as dynamic) with its own default expression overridden by the explicit expression slot (fierce-focused.json) -- fitting a dragon confrontation far better, and proving the field-name override rule: the explicit 'expression' slot wins, the motion's own embedded expression field is dropped from the join.
